items.title: Today, Week and Lists
items.description: With Tasks plugin support on, the app opens on Today: overdue and today's tasks, ready to tick off. Week shows the rest of the week by day, Lists your notes grouped by folder.

items.title: Repeat Picker
items.description: Set how a task repeats with a few taps: every day, week, month or year, on chosen weekdays, from when it's done, and delete when done.

items.title: Contexts
items.description: Tags like #kontext/zuhause show as labels, filter Today, Week and lists, and can be picked in the editor. Set the tag in Settings → Task markers.

items.title: Status Labels
items.description: Name your custom statuses, e.g. w as Waiting, and long-press the checkbox to change a status.

items.title: Recurring Tasks Fixed
items.description: Tasks with 🏁 delete now recur, and tags between dates no longer hide a task's due date.
